request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

excluded: Preprocessing, normalization, RoPE, softmax, activations and elementwise gates
Graph padding, masked implementation arithmetic and TP-replicated work
limitations: The catalog combines disjoint model-semantic families, not complete device execution.
MoE projections assume full-range no-capacity-drop routing; actual routed rows are not device-counted.
Attention lengths and recurrent eligibility are host-observed without same-run device validation.
No cross-run time denominator, effective FLOP/s, reference capacity or acceptance percentage is derived.
Draft vocabulary rows are source-mapped replay arguments, not internal kernel observations.
